About This Auction

*ONLINE-ONLY AUCTION* PROPERTY: 22 +/- Acres in Sedgwick County, Kansas near Valley Center AUCTION DATE: April 3rd, 2025 at 6 PM Central Right in the sweet spot of property sizes to build a rural home, not too big and not too small! This 22-acre parcel is perfect for building your country home with space to roam. Room to raise kids, grow a garden, dig a pond, or have some livestock! This online-only auction will give everyone an opportunity to purchase this highly desired property. Go to the “L2 Realty Auctions” app or https://l2realtyinc.bidwrangler.com/ui for more details and how to register.  Access: Just a quarter mile off blacktop 125th Street, access comes from a well-maintained gravel road. There is an abundance of road frontage on Seneca Street too.  A short 5-minute drive south and you can pull into the parking lot of Valley Center High School! For those commuting to Wichita, you’re just 1.5 miles away from I-135 and it’s a straight shot into town from there! Scenery: The land is open and scenic, offering incredible sunsets when looking to the west. Surrounding properties have many trees giving the feeling of privacy even with several houses in the area. Utilities: Electricity is running along Seneca and rural water is available at the road. A private well could be dug to provide additional water for your homestead.   Don’t miss out on a great opportunity to secure a rural, spacious build site in the Valley Center School District! Interested in this property? Please call or email the listing agent, Tyler Gentry, at (316) 641-3173 or tgentry@L2realtyinc.com to set up your showing. Create your land legacy!   22 +/- Total Acres Electricity Available Rural Water Available Short drive to Wichita 6 minutes to Valley Center, KS 15 minutes to Newton, KS 20 minutes to Wichita, KS
